fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld, Arc Publishing CMS -- NewsArticle or OpinionNewsArticle ld+json with full articleBody inline) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, /arc/outboundfeeds/rss/) carry title/link-style headline fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle/OpinionNewsArticle ld+json node.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, carried inline in the ld+json article node (no HTML fallback needed on this site).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), normalized from either an Organization author dict (staff/wire content) or a list of Person author dicts (bylined opinion columns).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag from ld+json.

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: True when isAccessibleForFree is explicitly false.

isPartOf.title: Is part of
isPartOf.description: Subscription-product block naming the paywall tier (e.g. 'Acceso Digital Monthly Test'), present on some articles -- raw passthrough.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: List of keywords, already list-shaped in the upstream ld+json.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher reference -- only a JSON-LD @id reference (not a resolved name), passed through raw.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item.

category.title: Category
category.description: RSS <category> value of a latest-mode item.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
